query:
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversations c
                          WHERE c.id = $1
                            AND (c.buyer_user_id = $2 OR c.seller_user_id = $2
                                 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM business_members bm
                                            WHERE bm.business_id = c.seller_business_id AND bm.user_id = $2))) AS "may_see!"
